notes.title: Employee Update
notes.notes:
[b]The employees have been modified so that they are now coming to work when you enter the game and do not go home until you finish playing[/b]

[i]They were modified at the request of the players[/i]

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [list][*][p][b]The warehouse door has been fixed upon reaching the level of 20, it will be opened permanently[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]When the store is closed, the time will be stopped and when the store is open, it will complete the count time[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]The price change is now happening every 10 days[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i][b]Note: There will be an update for the price change system[/b][/i][/p]
